title: Israyelu Raja – Freddy Paul Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నా తండ్రి నీవే – నా తల్లి నీవే
నా తోడు నీవే – నా నీడవు నీవే
english: Naa thandri neeve naa thalli neeve
Naa thodu neeve naa needavu neeve
translation: O King of Israel, praise be to You.
O Son of David, praise be to You.
O Holy Spirit God, praise be to You.
O Triune God, all praise and glory belong to You.
1. You are my Creator, O God.
You are my ruler and authority, O Lord.
You are my Father and also like a mother to me.
You are my very identity and reflection.
2. You are my Savior, O Jesus.
You are the one who guides my thoughts, O Messiah.
You are my life, You are my eternal life.
You are present in every part of me.
3. You are my comforter, O Holy Spirit.
You are my giver of peace, O King of Salem (Prince of Peace).
You are my companion and my shelter.
You are the light of my soul.
intro: Israyelu Raja is the latest Telugu Christian song, sung by Freddy Paul. This song was released on March 19, 2026, through HOSANNA MINISTRIES KURNOOL YouTube Channel.
